generation_settings.grammar:
char ::= [^"\\\x7F\x00-\x1F] | [\\] (["\\bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4})
json-array ::= "[" space ("]" | json-value (space "," space json-value)* space "]")
json-bool ::= "true" | "false"
json-null ::= "null"
json-number ::= "-"? ("0" | [1-9] [0-9]*) ("." [0-9]+)? (("e" | "E") [+-]? [0-9]+)?
json-object ::= "{" space ("}" | json-string space ":" space json-value (space "," space json-string space ":" space json-value)* space "}")
json-string ::= "\"" ( [^"\\] | "\\" ( ["\\/ bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4} ) )* "\""
json-value ::= json-object | json-array | json-string | json-number | json-bool | json-null
root ::= tool-call | tool-calls
space ::= | " " | "\n"{1,2} [ \t]{0,20}
string ::= "\"" char* "\""
tool-call ::= "<tool_call>\n" space (tool-list-files | tool-read-file | tool-search | tool-replace-text | tool-write-file | tool-finish) space "</tool_call>"
tool-calls ::= (tool-call? space)+
tool-finish ::= "{" space "\"name\"" space ":" space ("\"" "finish" "\"") space "," space "\"arguments\"" space ":" space tool-finish-schema space "}"
tool-finish-schema ::= "{" space tool-finish-schema-answer-kv space "}"

tool-read-file ::= "{" space "\"name\"" space ":" space ("\"" "read_file" "\"") space "," space "\"arguments\"" space ":" space tool-read-file-schema space "}"
tool-read-file-schema ::= "{" space tool-read-file-schema-path-kv space "}"
tool-read-file-schema-path ::= "\"" char+ "\""
tool-read-file-schema-path-kv ::= "\"path\"" space ":" space tool-read-file-schema-path
tool-replace-text ::= "{" space "\"name\"" space ":" space ("\"" "replace_text" "\"") space "," space "\"arguments\"" space ":" space tool-replace-text-schema space "}"
tool-replace-text-schema ::= "{" space tool-replace-text-schema-path-kv "," space tool-replace-text-schema-oldText-kv "," space tool-replace-text-schema-newText-kv space "}"

tool-replace-text-schema-path ::= "\"" char+ "\""
